mechanism: Only on four distinct distance-code slots already being full, replace a slot that is dominated under the current SF length/distance-price model by the incoming match or another retained match. Preserve search depth and normal non-full path; permit useful later choices without increasing buffer capacity.
difference_from_old_work: Earlier seed-tail pruning added checks on every query and slowed total time. This tests lost quality at a bounded buffer overflow, not that CPU filter or another search-depth sweep. Actual overflow opportunity and full encoded effect are measured together.

attribution.proof: New pure slot selector and modified fastadd signature not yet migrated; this Lean file is a draft only.
